svg.title: www-split: the filed workline
svg.desc: The armed www-split workline: how a change is promoted, and the filed issues in the order they can close.
svg.text: www-split
r-arch#61 open, In progress.
r-arch#61
First promote has landed. 1 of 6 done.
How a change gets to production
Work lands on www-ng branch ng. The Founder merges that branch into www-ng main.
That merge is the only promote button. A workflow fast-forwards the commit onto www-prod main, and production deploys it.

g.text: new sibling · public · not a fork
Pull request from ng is required.
Pages does not deploy this branch.

svg.text: 1 · PR
Founder merges
2 · ff-only
promote.yml
The same deploy.yml, promote.yml, and site code are in both repositories. Git does not name the site.
URL, noindex, and deploy branch are repository variables, so a promote cannot carry ng's noindex or canonicals onto production.

If www-prod main has moved ahead, the fast-forward fails and does not force-push. www-ng main has already moved, so it stops mirroring until the two are reconciled. Company links stay www.enterprise-r.com.
What must differ, and must not be in git
website#59 sets the production variables before the new workflow lands. sys-github#28 sets www-ng's variables and does not store PROMOTE_TOKEN.
Both sites stay public. GitHub Free serves Pages only from public repositories.

g.text: History copy onto main and ng. Not a fork.
Founder stores it after sys-github#28 closes.
Pushes and PRs blocked. Bot bypasses.

svg.text: DNS
docs#27, assigned to enterprise-r-bots, after the Pages domain is set. ng CNAME enterprise-r.github.io.
No new challenge TXT, and no CNAME file in git. A Squarespace sign-in goes to the Founder. Mounts stay under /r/media/projects/.
Filed, and the order they can close
website#59 lands first. sys-github#28 follows that landing, and it does not store the promote token.
docs#26 can proceed now. The mounts, the DNS issue, and the token wait until www-ng exists. There is still no issue on www-ng.

a.text: 1 of 6 sub-issues closed. neg3ntropy leads. The Founder merges the promote pull request.

svg.text: NOT WAITING ON THE RENAME · docs#26 IS UNBLOCKED NOW

a.text: The mounts, the copied history, and the promote
exception. The ng CNAME is docs#27, not this issue.
Names both mounts, branch ng, and the promote.

svg.text: LAND FIRST · BEFORE www-ng EXISTS

a.text: Drive URL, noindex, and deploy from variables
Land this on production main before www-ng is created, so the history copy includes it. Set the production variables before the new deploy workflow.
sys-github#28 · In progress · after website#59 has landed
Rename to www-prod and create www-ng
Public sibling, history copied onto main and ng, not a fork. Variables and Pages, then the rulesets. Do not create PROMOTE_TOKEN.
This issue configures the Pages domain. The certificate and the live staging URL wait on docs#27.

svg.text: ONCE www-ng EXISTS · THESE DO NOT WAIT ON EACH OTHER

a.text: After the Pages domain is set.
Squarespace CNAME, and the dns.md row.
A sign-in goes to the Founder.

g.text: Does not wait on the other issues.

svg.text: AFTER THE MOUNTS EXIST
Each machine runs mani sync, adds upstream on the www-ng checkout, and deletes the old website checkout. Point engy's look path at /r/media/projects/www-prod.
Confirm www and the apex still serve production and stay indexable.
NOT THIS WORKLINE
Pointing www at the preview. A second pull request or an Approve environment on www-prod. A GitHub fork. A sub-issue on www-ng. A later deploy system (r-arch#59).
First promote has landed on www. The ng DNS record is not on main yet.
